vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
攻击或技能造成重击（眩晕目标）；有概率、固定攻击次数或技能触发都算
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
攻击伤害波及周围单位
使目标短暂离开战场，期间无敌或不可被选取
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
受到攻击或伤害时触发的反击伤害：按比例返还所受伤害、固定值反击，或受伤触发的范围伤害（如半人马·反伤、斧王·反击螺旋、钢毛后背）；攻击者不一定被打到也算，记条件
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
单位进入虚无状态：无法攻击，也不会受到物理攻击；魔法和纯粹伤害仍可作用
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
降低或禁止目标的任何形式生命恢复，含属性回复；提升生命上限的效果不受影响
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
攻击无视闪避（必中）
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
提高技能造成的伤害
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
能摧毁树木

objects.subject: arcane_blink
objects.description_en: Active: Arcane Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.   After teleportation, you restore %heal_amount% health and %mana_amount% mana.  Arcane Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

objects.subject: arcane_boots
objects.description_en: Active: Replenish Restores %replenish_amount% mana to all nearby allies.  Radius: %replenish_radius%   Passive: Basilius Aura Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.    Radius: %aura_radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Does not work on Meepo clones.

objects.subject: armlet
objects.description_en: Toggle: Unholy Strength When active, Unholy Strength grants +%unholy_bonus_damage% damage, +%unholy_bonus_strength% strength and +%unholy_bonus_armor% armor, but drains %unholy_health_drain_per_second% health per second.   You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.
notes_en: The strength change will affect both maximum and current HP, but you cannot die from the change.
The strength change occurs over 0.6 seconds.
Activating or deactivating Unholy Strength does not interrupt channeling.

objects.subject: assault
objects.description_en: Passive: Assault Aura  Grants %aura_attack_speed% attack speed and %aura_positive_armor% armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by %aura_negative_armor%.  Radius: %aura_radius%

objects.subject: basher
objects.description_en: Passive: Bash  Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%%% chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage.  Bash chance for ranged heroes is %bash_chance_ranged%%%.
notes_en: Does not stack with other sources of Bash.
The following heroes cannot trigger Bash on this item: Spirit Breaker, Faceless Void, Slardar, and Kez while in Sai mode.
Does not grant Bash to Clones and Tempest Doubles.

objects.subject: bfury
objects.description_en: Active: Chop Tree  Destroy a target tree.    Passive: Quell  Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %quelling_bonus% for melee heroes, and %quelling_bonus_ranged% for ranged.    Passive: Cleave  Deals %cleave_damage_percent%%% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to %cleave_distance% around the target. Deals %cleave_damage_percent_creep%%% against creeps. (Melee Only)
notes_en: Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
If multiple sources of Cleave are present, each Cleave's damage is applied separately.

objects.subject: black_grimoire
objects.description_en: Use: Profane Knowledge Hero kills and assists empower the Black Grimoire, granting it charges. Right-click to consume and grant %xp_per_charge% experience per charge. Starts on cooldown.   This item cannot be dropped.

objects.subject: black_king_bar
objects.description_en: Active: Avatar  Applies a basic dispel. Grants %spell_reduce%%% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.   Duration: %duration%s  Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

objects.subject: blade_mail
objects.description_en: Active: Damage Return For %duration% seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by %active_reflection_pct%%%.   Passive: Damage Return Everytime you are attacked, you return %passive_reflection_constant% damage plus %passive_reflection_pct%%% of the attack damage dealt to you.
notes_en: Damage Return is calculated before any kind of reduction.
Returned damage type is the same as it was received.
Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

objects.subject: blight_stone
objects.description_en: Passive: Lesser Corruption  Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.
notes_en: Does not stack with its upgrades, Desolator, or Stygian Desolator.

objects.subject: blink
objects.description_en: Active: Blink  Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.   Blink Dagger cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes_en: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

objects.subject: blood_grenade
objects.description_en: Use: Throw Grenade  Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow%%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration% seconds. Radius %radius%.

objects.subject: bloodstone
objects.description_en: Active: Bloodpact  Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to %spell_lifesteal_while_active%%%. Lasts %buff_duration% seconds.    Passive: Spell Weakness Aura  Enemy units take %aura_spell_vulnerability%%% increased damage from spells.   Radius: %aura_radius%
notes_en: Spell Weakness Aura does not stack with Veil of Discord's Spell Weakness.

objects.subject: bloodthorn
objects.description_en: Active: Soul Rend  Silences a target for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional %silence_damage_percent%%% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.  All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.   Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %proc_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %passive_proc_damage% bonus magical damage.

objects.subject: boots_of_bearing
objects.description_en: Active: Endurance  Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds. For the first %bonus_ms_duration% seconds allies are immune to slows.   Radius: %radius%     Passive: Swiftness Aura Grants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.    Radius: %radius% Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

objects.subject: bottle
objects.description_en: Active: Regenerate Consumes a charge to restore %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana over %restore_time% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.  The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.  Hold Control to use on an allied hero.   Passive:  Store Rune Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.  Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
notes_en: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.

objects.subject: buckler
objects.description_en: Passive: Buckler Aura  Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.  Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%

objects.subject: butterfly
notes_en: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

objects.subject: cheese
objects.description_en: Use: Fondue  Instantly restores %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana.
notes_en: Cheese is shareable.

objects.subject: consecrated_wraps
objects.description_en: Passive: Hallowed  Gain a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s, up to a maximum of %AbilityCharges% charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by %movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%%% for %duration%s.  Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for %duration%s that absorbs %barrier_per_stack% damage per charge (%max_barrier_tooltip% max).
notes_en: Charges cannot be gained for %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s after you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan.
Self-damage and HP Loss damage cannot remove charges.
Movement speed buff does not stack.

objects.subject: crellas_crozier
objects.description_en: Active: Rite of Rumusque  You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.  Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second. Movement speed steal lasts %stack_duration%s.  Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to %active_health_steal%%%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.   Passive: Putrefaction Aura Reduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by %health_steal%%%.  Radius: %radius%
notes_en: Ghost form ends if you become Debuff Immune and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Putrefaction Aura does not redirect Health Restoration from enemy heroes that are at full health.

objects.subject: crimson_guard
objects.description_en: Active: Guard  For %duration% seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a %block_chance_active%%% chance to block damage equal to %block_damage_active% plus %max_hp_pct%%% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.  Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%   Passive: Damage Block  Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
notes_en: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.
When the Guard buff is applied to ranged heroes, Guard blocks %block_penalty_ranged% less damage.
Guard does not affect units that have been affected by Guard within Crimson Guard's cooldown.

objects.subject: cyclone
objects.description_en: Active: Cyclone  Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.  Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: You cannot cyclone allies.
Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

objects.subject: dagon
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Burst  Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.  Damage: %damage%  Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes_en: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

objects.subject: dagon_2
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Burst  Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.  Damage: %damage%  Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes_en: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.
